text: Abstract Objective To retrospectively study the induction and duration of rifampin on voriconazole trough concentration and the interfering factors of the interaction between rifampin and voriconazole. Methods The data of patients in our hospital who had been treated with voriconazole and rifampin and also underwent voriconazole TDM from May 2018 to December 2022 was collected. The basic information, rifampin regimen, voriconazole regimen, other co-medications and voriconazole TDM results were analyzed. Results A total of 32 patients were collected;
